atoms/aspect-ratio.description:
Re-export of Radix's `AspectRatio.Root`. Pass `ratio` (number, e.g.
`16/9`) to lock a child's aspect ratio.

props.name: ratio
props.description:
Aspect ratio expressed as a number (e.g. `16/9`, `4/3`, `1`). The
child element is sized to fit this ratio while preserving the
container's width.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — useful when wrapping a custom container that
already has its own DOM element.

atoms/avatar.description:
Round profile-image container. Composes `Avatar` + `AvatarImage` +
`AvatarFallback`. Defaults to `h-10 w-10`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — wrap a custom element while keeping the
Avatar's image-loading behaviour.

props.name: children
props.description: Avatar content — typically `<AvatarImage>` + `<AvatarFallback>`.

atoms/avatar.description:
Rendered when the image is missing or still loading — typically initials,
an icon, or a silhouette.

props.name: delayMs
props.description:
Wait this many ms before showing the fallback (avoids flash on fast
image loads).

props.name: children
props.description: Initials, icon, or silhouette.

atoms/avatar.description: The `` slot inside ``. Hides itself if loading errors so the fallback can render.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Hides itself if loading errors so the fallback can render.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible label. Defaults to the empty string for decorative use.

props.name: onLoadingStatusChange
props.description: Radix lifecycle hook for tracking the load state.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style. `default` is filled brand colour, `secondary` is a muted
neutral, `outline` is bordered with no fill, `destructive` flags an
error or warning state.

props.name: children
props.description: Badge label or any nested elements.

atoms/brand-mark.description:
Generic brand-mark primitive. Renders a single SVG `path` either with
`currentColor` (the default) or with a two-stop linear gradient when both
`from` and `to` are provided. Sizing is controlled via `className`
(`h-10 w-auto`); the SVG honours its `viewBox` aspect ratio.

Apps consuming canvas typically build a thin wrapper around this component
that hard-codes their own brand path / gradient — see the docs site's
`OlympusLogo` for a worked example.

props.name: path
props.description:
SVG path data (`d` attribute) for the brand mark. Required — canvas
does not ship a default brand shape; consuming apps supply their own.

props.name: viewBox
props.description: SVG `viewBox` matching the path's coordinate space.

props.name: transform
props.description:
Optional inner `transform` applied to the path's `<g>` group — useful
when the path coordinates need to be translated, rotated, or scaled
relative to the viewBox.

props.name: from
props.description:
Gradient start colour. When omitted, the path is filled with
`currentColor` and no gradient is generated.

props.name: to
props.description: Gradient end colour. Required when `from` is set.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual emphasis preset. `default` is the primary action, `destructive`
is for irreversible actions, `outline` and `secondary` are quieter,
`ghost` is borderless, `link` looks like body-text underlined.

props.name: size
props.description:
Height + horizontal padding preset. `sm` is 32px, `default` is 36px,
`lg` is 40px, `icon` is square 36×36 for icon-only buttons (always
pair with `aria-label`).

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards className and behaviour onto the
immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper `<button>`.
Common pattern for using a router `<Link>` while keeping the Button
styling.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label or any nested elements (icons, badges).

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the root element via `cn()`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
When true, dims the button to 50% opacity and blocks pointer/keyboard
input.

props.name: type
props.description:
Native HTML button type. `submit` triggers parent form submission;
`reset` resets parent form fields; `button` does neither.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. Receives a `MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form name when this button submits/resets a form (for forms with multiple buttons).

props.name: value
props.description: Form value sent with the form when this button is the submitter.

props.name: form
props.description:
ID of the form this button belongs to, when the button sits outside
the `<form>` element.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Tab order. Default behaviour is one of native `<button>` tab focus.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label, required for icon-only buttons (`size="icon"`).

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of an element that describes the button's purpose.

atoms/checkbox.description:
Wraps Radix's `Checkbox.Root`. The check glyph is rendered inside
automatically.

props.name: checked
props.description:
Controlled checked state. Pass `'indeterminate'` to render the dash
glyph instead of the check.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires when the user toggles the checkbox. Use this instead of `onChange`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims to 50% and blocks input.

props.name: required
props.description: Block native form submit unless the box is checked.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for native form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: Form field value when submitted.

props.name: direction
props.description: Maps to `flex-direction`.

props.name: align
props.description: Maps to `align-items`.

props.name: justify
props.description: Maps to `justify-content`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Tailwind gap step (0–6) or a raw CSS value.

props.name: wrap
props.description:
Maps to `flex-wrap`. Pass `true` for `flex-wrap`, `false` for
`flex-nowrap`.

props.name: name
props.description:
Lucide icon name (PascalCase, e.g. `ChevronRight`, `Mail`). Only icons
re-exported through `lucide-react` are valid.

props.name: size
props.description:
Pixel size of the rendered SVG. Defaults to 16; pass any number to
override (e.g. 20, 24).

atoms/input.description:
Styled wrapper around the native `<input>` — 36px tall, rounded-md, 1px
border, transparent background, canvas focus ring. Forwards every native
input attribute through to the underlying element.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Native HTML5 validation regex. Triggers `:invalid` if the value doesn't match.

props.name: type
props.description:
Native input type. Drives keyboard, validation, and on iOS the
picker.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled value. Pair with `onChange`. For uncontrolled inputs use
`defaultValue` instead.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for an uncontrolled input. Ignored if `value` is also passed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text shown when the input is empty. Renders in `text-muted-foreground`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Visually dims to 50% and blocks all input. Pair with `Label` so the
dim cascades.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Selectable but not editable. Useful for displaying server-set values.

props.name: required
props.description: Block native form submit unless the input has a value.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Required when relying on uncontrolled native form submission.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM id. Match this from `<Label htmlFor>` for screen-reader association.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Browser autofill hint. See MDN for the full token list.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the input on mount. Use sparingly — surprises keyboard users.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character count limit for text inputs.

props.name: minLength
props.description: Minimum character count for text inputs.

props.name: min
props.description: Numeric / date lower bound. Honoured by `type="number"` / `"date"` / `"time"` / `"range"`.

props.name: max
props.description: Numeric / date upper bound.

props.name: step
props.description: Step increment for `number` / `range` / `date` types.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires on every keystroke. Read `e.target.value`. Required if you pass `value`.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Focus event. Common for focus-driven typeahead lookups.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Blur event. Common for blur-validation.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description:
ID of the form control this label describes. Sets `for` on the
underlying `<label>` so screen readers and click-to-focus work.
Match this with the input's `id`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<label>`.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text. Can include nested elements (icons, helper text).

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the label via `cn()`.

atoms/logo.description: Brand-agnostic logo slot. - With no `src`: renders the default Olympus mark (gradient ring or sideways-O icon based on `variant`). The `icon` variant supports `showText` for the "○lympus" wordmark lockup. - With `src`: renders an `` so consumers can drop in their own brand. Sizing: the `size` prop maps to `width`/`height` for the `icon` and `src` paths; the `ring` path is sized via `className` (e.g. `className="h-10 w-auto"`) because its viewBox aspect ratio is non-square.

props.name: src
props.description: Custom logo image. When provided, renders an `` instead of the default Olympus mark. Apps consuming canvas pass their own brand here.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text for the custom-image variant. Required when `src` is set.

props.name: size
props.description: Pixel size for the icon variant and any custom `src` image. Default 24.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Default-mark variant (only consulted when `src` is not provided).
- `icon` (default): the small sideways-O ellipse rendered with `currentColor`.
- `ring`: the larger stadium/ring mark filled with the Olympus blue gradient.
  Best for header/decorative use ≥ 40px.

props.name: showText
props.description: When true and using the default `icon` variant, renders "○lympus" wordmark.

props.name: value
props.description:
Current progress as a number between `0` and `max`. When `null` the
indicator renders in indeterminate mode (Radix's default
loading-spinner-style fill).

props.name: max
props.description:
Maximum value the progress can reach. The fill width is
`value / max * 100%`.

props.name: getValueLabel
props.description:
Function that returns the accessible label announcing the current
value to screen readers. Defaults to `"X%"`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<div>`.

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the track via `cn()`.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled selected value. Pair with `onValueChange`. Match the
`value` of one of the child `<RadioGroupItem>`s.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial selected value for uncontrolled usage. Ignored if `value` is
also passed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires when the user picks a different option.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every radio in the group.

props.name: required
props.description:
Required for native form submission — at least one option must be
selected.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Required when relying on uncontrolled native form submission.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction of the radios.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction of the group. Affects keyboard arrow navigation.

props.name: loop
props.description:
When true, arrow-key navigation wraps from the last item back to the
first.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<div>`.

props.name: children
props.description: A flat list of `<RadioGroupItem>`s.

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the group via `cn()`.

props.name: value
props.description:
Value reported when this radio is selected. Required — must match
the parent `<RadioGroup>`'s `value` for selection to register.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables only this radio.

props.name: required
props.description: Required for native form submission.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<button>`.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional inner content (visual only — Radix provides the indicator).

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the radio button via `cn()`.

props.name: type
props.description:
When the scrollbar is shown:
- `"hover"` reveals on hover and 600ms after scroll
- `"scroll"` reveals only while scrolling
- `"auto"` defers to OS conventions (always-visible on Linux/Win)
- `"always"` keeps the scrollbar visible at all times

props.name: scrollHideDelay
props.description:
How long the scrollbar lingers after scroll/hover ends, in ms. Only
applies when `type` is `"hover"` or `"scroll"`.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction. Affects which side the vertical scrollbar lives on.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<div>`.

props.name: children
props.description: Scrollable content.

props.name: className
props.description:
Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the root via `cn()`. Set the
height/max-height here so the scroll area knows when to scroll.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which axis the scrollbar controls.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Force the scrollbar to mount even when it's not needed (no overflow).
Pair with a CSS animation that fades in/out based on `data-state`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<div>`.

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the scrollbar via `cn()`.

props.name: spacing
props.description:
Vertical-rhythm step applied as `space-y-*` between immediate children.
Maps to Tailwind's spacing scale: `0` = 0, `1` = 8px, `2` = 16px,
`3` = 24px, `4` = 32px, `5` = 40px, `6` = 48px.

props.name: children
props.description: Section content — typically a heading + body, or stacked cards.

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the root `<div>` via `cn()`.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM id, useful when linked to from a `<Label>` or anchor `#hash`.

props.name: role
props.description:
ARIA role override. Pass `"region"` (paired with `aria-label` /
`aria-labelledby`) when the section should be a navigable landmark
for screen-reader users.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for landmark-role sections.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of an element that labels the section (e.g. its heading).

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of an element that describes the section.

atoms/separator.description: Thin divider line — horizontal (default) or vertical.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Layout direction. `horizontal` is a 1px row spanning width;
`vertical` is a 1px column spanning height.

props.name: decorative
props.description:
When true (default), the separator is hidden from screen readers. Set
to false for separators that have semantic meaning.

atoms/skeleton.description:
Animated placeholder for content that's loading. Set width/height via
className; Skeleton fills with a pulsing tinted block.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled value. Pass an array — single-thumb sliders use a length-1
tuple (`[40]`), range sliders use length-2 (`[20, 80]`). Pair with
`onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for uncontrolled usage. Same array shape as `value`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires on every move. Use this for live previews.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Fires when the user releases the thumb (commit handler).

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value the slider can reach.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value the slider can reach.

props.name: step
props.description: Quantum the slider snaps to. Set to `1` for integer-only values.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description:
Minimum gap between two thumbs in a range slider. Ignored for
single-thumb sliders.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction. Affects which end is "min" on the visual axis.

props.name: inverted
props.description: Whether the slider is inverted — flips which end is "min".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the slider.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Required when relying on uncontrolled native form submission.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards props onto the immediate child
element instead of rendering a wrapper `<span>`.

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the slider via `cn()`.

atoms/switch.description:
Wraps Radix's `Switch.Root` — a binary on/off toggle. Pair with `<Label>`
for accessibility.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires when the user flips the switch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims and blocks input.

props.name: required
props.description: Block native form submit unless the switch is on.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for native form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: Form field value when submitted.

atoms/textarea.description:
Styled wrapper around the native `<textarea>`. 60px min-height, rounded-md,
1px border, transparent background.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Pair with `onChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text shown when empty.

props.name: rows
props.description:
Visible row count. Canvas's default min-height is 60px regardless;
`rows` overrides.

props.name: cols
props.description: Visible column count (width). Canvas overrides this with `w-full`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dim and block input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Selectable but not editable.

props.name: required
props.description: Block native form submit unless the textarea has a value.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for native form submission.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM id for `<Label htmlFor>` association.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Browser autofill hint.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus on mount.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character count upper limit.

props.name: minLength
props.description: Character count lower limit.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires on every keystroke.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Fires on focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Fires on blur.

props.name: variant
props.description: `default` (filled when on) or `outline` (bordered).

props.name: size
props.description: Square size — `sm` (32px), `default` (36px), or `lg` (40px).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled pressed state. Pair with `onPressedChange`.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Initial pressed state for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Fires when the user toggles the pressed state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the toggle.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as a Radix Slot.

props.name: children
props.description: Toggle content (typically an icon or short label).

charts/activity-heatmap.description:
CSS-grid heatmap of opacity-tinted cells. Useful for time-of-day × day-of-week
matrices (token issuance, sign-in concentration, queue depth) where a full
chart would be overkill. Rendering is a flat `display: grid` — no canvas, no
SVG, fully interactive via hover titles.

props.name: data
props.description:
Cell values in row-major order. Each entry is a number in `[0, 1]`
where `0` paints the lowest tint and `1` paints the highest. Values are
clamped on render. The grid dimensions come from `data.length` and
`data[0].length`; pass jagged arrays only if you accept short rows.

props.name: colorVar
props.description:
CSS variable name (without leading `--`) used for the cell hue. Default
`chart-1`. Cells render as `hsl(var(--{colorVar}) / opacity)`.

props.name: cellHeight
props.description: Pixel height of each cell row. Default `14`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Pixel gap between cells. Default `2`.

props.name: cellRadius
props.description: Pixel border-radius on each cell. Default `3`.

props.name: cellTitle
props.type: ((row: number, col: number, value: number) => string)
props.description:
Render the cell `title` attribute (browser tooltip on hover) for each
coordinate. Receives `(rowIndex, colIndex, value)` and should return a
string. Returns nothing → no title set.

props.name: active
props.description:
If true, then Tooltip is always displayed, once an activeIndex is set by mouse over, or programmatically.
If false, then Tooltip is never displayed.
If active is undefined, Recharts will control when the Tooltip displays. This includes mouse and keyboard controls.

props.name: includeHidden
props.description: If true, then Tooltip will information about hidden series (defaults to false). Interacting with the hide property of Area, Bar, Line, Scatter.

props.name: onKeyPress
props.description: @deprecated Use `onKeyUp` or `onKeyDown` instead

props.name: onKeyPressCapture
props.description: @deprecated Use `onKeyUpCapture` or `onKeyDownCapture` instead

props.name: onClick
props.type: (AdaptChildMouseEventHandler<any, SVGElement> & ((data: any, index: number, e: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>) => void))

props.name: onMouseEnter
props.type: (AdaptChildMouseEventHandler<any, SVGElement> & ((data: any, index: number, e: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>) => void))

props.name: onMouseLeave
props.type: (AdaptChildMouseEventHandler<any, SVGElement> & ((data: any, index: number, e: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>) => void))

charts/gauge.description:
Single-arc circular gauge with a centered value. Useful for adoption
percentages, health scores, completion ratios, and similar 0–100 metrics.
Renders a complete background ring plus a filled arc; the arc is animated
via `transition-[stroke-dashoffset]` so consumers get smooth updates when
`value` changes.

props.name: value
props.description: Percentage to fill (0–100). Values outside the range are clamped.

props.name: size
props.description: Pixel size (width = height). Default `160`.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Pixel stroke width of the ring. Default `14`.

props.name: colorVar
props.description:
CSS variable name (without leading `--`) used for the filled arc. Default
`chart-1`.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description:
Center value text. Defaults to `"{value}%"`. Pass a custom node to render
something richer (e.g. a unit label).

props.name: caption
props.description: Small label rendered below the centre value. Optional.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label describing the gauge. Default `"Gauge"`.

charts/labeled-bar-list.description:
Vertical list of labeled rows with a horizontal progress bar per row. Useful
for "top regions", "schema usage", "provider connections" — anywhere a small
set of named values needs proportional comparison without a full chart.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows rendered top-to-bottom.

props.name: colorVar
props.description:
CSS variable name (without leading `--`) used for the bar fill. Default
`chart-1`.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Format the value rendered to the right of each label. Default `toLocaleString`.

props.name: barHeight
props.description: Pixel height of the row's bar track. Default `4`.

props.name: caption
props.description: Caption rendered below the list.

charts/service-health-list.description:
Vertical list of services with a colored status dot, name, and optional
monospace meta cells (latency, uptime, region, …). The dot has a 3-px halo
matching the status hue at 18% opacity to pull focus.

props.name: items
props.description: Service rows rendered top-to-bottom.

props.name: caption
props.description: Caption rendered below the list.

charts/stacked-bar.description:
Horizontal stacked-percent bar with an optional swatch legend below. Segments
are sized proportionally to their value's share of the total — pass raw
counts or pre-computed percentages, the rendering is the same.

props.name: segments
props.description: Segments rendered left-to-right with width proportional to `value`.

props.name: defaultColorVar
props.description:
Fallback CSS variable name for segments that omit `colorVar`. Default
`chart-1`.

props.name: height
props.description: Pixel height of the bar pill. Default `10`.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the legend list below the bar. Default `true`.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Format the per-segment value in the legend. Default `(v) => `${v}%``.

props.name: caption
props.description: Caption rendered below the legend.

props.name: points
props.description: Geo-located points to render. Empty array shows the empty-state overlay.

props.name: height
props.description: Container height. Number → px, string passes through. Default `"100%"`.

props.name: center
props.description: Initial map center `[lat, lng]`. Default `[20, 0]`.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Initial zoom. Default `3`.

props.name: tileTheme
props.description: Tile basemap. `"auto"` follows canvas's `useTheme()`. Default `"auto"`.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show Leaflet zoom + attribution controls. Default `false`.

props.name: markerColor
props.description: Marker fill (any CSS colour, including `hsl(var(--chart-1))`). Default `"hsl(var(--chart-1))"`.

props.name: markerRadiusRange
props.description: `[min, max]` marker radius in pixels (log-scaled on `count`). Default `[4, 20]`.

props.name: onMarkerClick
props.description: Per-marker click handler.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show "Fewer / More" legend overlay (bottom-left). Default `true`.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional title overlaid top-left.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Override the empty-state node. Default: a small "No geographic data available" card.

props.name: className
props.description: Pass-through className on the outer `.world-heat-map` wrapper.

props.name: subject
props.description: Bold subject (the actor).

props.name: action
props.description: Muted action verb + object.

props.name: timestamp
props.description: Right-aligned timestamp.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading icon or avatar slot.

props.name: onClick
props.description: When provided, the row becomes clickable.

props.name: index
props.description:
Index in a list — when 0, the top border is suppressed so consecutive
items only render dividers between rows. Defaults to 1 (border on).

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual emphasis preset. `default` is informational, `destructive`
